concept_comparison: Cone shape and restrained recess are useful. Concept only visibly shows three spicules and makes bases blade-like; model exactly four thin approximately cylindrical faceted spicules, not blades, with all four attachments exposed. Three rim points retained. Exact dimensions come from frozen art parameters within published diagnosis, not from image pixels.
known_limitations: Idealized positive external form, not a replica of the negative-hyporelief mould. Four is a selected reconstruction count, not universal biology; sponge-grade affinity and composition remain interpretations. Primary-author2015 PNAS Fig3B shows holotype SAM P43257; Fig3A is labeled reconstruction.2012 publisher plate and supplement unavailable and not claimed viewed.
